full_name: Ann Blair | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 History Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Harvard University
bio: Ann Blair is the Henry Charles Lea Professor of History at Harvard, where she focuses on the intellectual and cultural history of early modern Europe, with special interests in book history, the historical relations between science and religion, and French history.
